name: playwright
description: Live E2E browser automation via Microsoft's @playwright/cli: named sessions, accessibility-ref snapshots, click/fill by ref, screenshots, console and network capture, mocking, tracing, video, and auth state, with artifacts written to disk so only paths enter context, plus produced pull-request demo videos with frame-measured QC, a vendored upstream baseline and maintainer drift-check update flow.

demo_style.title: Demo video style
demo_style.description: Style of /playwright:demo-video output: produced (zoom on each action, captions, title card) or plain (the same replay and drawn cursor, no zoom, captions or title).

demo_title.title: Demo video: title card
demo_title.description: Open the demo video with a title card. The plain style has none whatever this says.

demo_camera.title: Demo video: camera zoom
demo_camera.description: Zoom and pan onto each action. The plain style has none whatever this says.

demo_cursor.title: Demo video: drawn cursor
demo_cursor.description: Draw the pointer traveling to and clicking each target.

demo_ripple.title: Demo video: click ripple
demo_ripple.description: Draw a ring around each clicked element.

demo_captions.title: Demo video: captions
demo_captions.description: Caption each step and its outcome. The plain style has none whatever this says.

demo_narration.title: Demo video: narration
demo_narration.description: Add a voice-over through /speech:narrate when the speech plugin is installed. Off by default.
